boundary: Independently held-out games and T-1 owner/static agreement predict only the hull mass component. VCR reveals target identity and site, never predictor features or calibration of mass. Nonship/hull-invalid VCRs are recorded out of scope; owner-ID and comparator gaps abstain rather than silently reassign owners. Neither equality nor residual proves Shield Generator phase, capture, Horwasp loss or a generative NuHost combat engine. Missing/conflicting specs fail closed. No executor or canonical DB mutation.
